usedFor: Cal ID takes the bookings and Google Calendar holds your schedule, so “Booking Created” can place the meeting with “Create Calendar Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal ID, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A new booking is the moment to add the meeting, and the action sets time, duration and attendees.

watchOut: “Booking Cancelled” pairs with “Delete Event”, which removes the calendar event, so test it on a throwaway booking.
